components.name: Icon Button
components.description: A restrained 48px smoked-glass utility action for reset, settings, and sheet close.
components.css: .ds-icon-button{width:48px;height:48px;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--hairline,rgba(245,240,234,.16));border-radius:var(--radius-sm,14px);background:rgba(28,21,18,.58);color:var(--text,#f5f0ea);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(116%);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.18);transition:background-color 180ms ease,border-color 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease}.ds-icon-button svg{width:23px;height:23px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-icon-button:hover{background:rgba(58,37,31,.68);border-color:rgba(245,240,234,.28)}.ds-icon-button:active{transform:scale(.96)}.ds-icon-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#f2b27f);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Three-Part Tool Selector
components.description: The shared frosted plane for selecting Pour, Stir, or Suction without fragmenting the toolbar into cards.
components.css: .ds-tool-selector{width:min(84vw,650px);min-height:116px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--hairline,rgba(245,240,234,.16));border-radius:var(--radius-sm,14px);background:var(--glass,rgba(18,14,12,.76));backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(112%);box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.26)}.ds-tool-button{min-width:0;min-height:104px;padding:14px 8px 18px;border:0;border-right:1px solid var(--hairline,rgba(245,240,234,.16));background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted,#c9bbb4);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:color 180ms ease,background-color 180ms ease}.ds-tool-button:last-child{border-right:0}.ds-tool-button svg{width:30px;height:30px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-tool-label{font:400 .96rem/1.2 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-tool-button::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:9px;left:27%;width:46%;height:4px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--wine,#a45a52);transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform 260ms var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-tool-button-active{color:var(--porcelain,#f5f0ea);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(56,30,26,.68),rgba(56,30,26,.22))}.ds-tool-button-active::after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-tool-button:hover{color:var(--text,#f5f0ea);background-color:rgba(245,240,234,.035)}.ds-tool-button:active{background-color:rgba(164,90,82,.16)}.ds-tool-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#f2b27f);outline-offset:-4px}

components.css: .ds-bottom-sheet{width:min(100%,620px);border:1px solid var(--hairline,rgba(245,240,234,.16));border-bottom:0;border-radius:var(--radius-sheet,24px) var(--radius-sheet,24px) 0 0;background:rgba(17,13,11,.9);color:var(--text,#f5f0ea);backdrop-filter:blur(28px) saturate(112%);box-shadow:0 -22px 46px rgba(0,0,0,.46);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-sheet-grip{display:block;width:44px;height:5px;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(245,240,234,.3)}.ds-sheet-header{min-height:68px;padding:8px 22px 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline,rgba(245,240,234,.16))}.ds-sheet-title{margin:0;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,5vw,2rem);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-sheet-close{width:44px;height:44px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:transparent;color:inherit;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms ease}.ds-sheet-close svg{width:23px;height:23px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round}.ds-sheet-close:hover{background:rgba(58,37,31,.68)}.ds-sheet-close:active{transform:scale(.96)}.ds-sheet-close:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#f2b27f);outline-offset:3px}.ds-sheet-section{padding:22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline,rgba(245,240,234,.16))}.ds-section-title{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:1rem;font-weight:520}.ds-sheet-copy{margin:0;color:var(--text-muted,#c9bbb4);font-size:.94rem}

components.name: Porcelain Canvas Stage
components.description: The dominant circular craft surface: matte porcelain surrounding a live coffee field with ambient physical depth.
components.css: .ds-canvas-stage{width:min(76vw,360px);aspect-ratio:1;position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;transition:transform 620ms var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)),filter 620ms var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-cup-shadow{position:absolute;inset:1%;border-radius:50%;background:#000;filter:blur(25px);opacity:.72;transform:translateY(18px) scale(.98)}.ds-porcelain-rim{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 46% 42%,#fffdfa 0 64%,#eee6dd 73%,#d7cbc0 80%,#f5f0ea 84% 100%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px rgba(70,45,32,.18);display:grid;place-items:center}.ds-coffee-surface{width:84%;height:84%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 44% 37%,#d8823c,#a94f1f 58%,#713016 100%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 16px rgba(43,18,8,.2)}.ds-keyboard-cursor{position:absolute;left:58%;top:46%;width:18px;height:18px;border:2px solid var(--focus,#f2b27f);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(242,178,127,.14);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.72);opacity:0;transition:opacity 180ms ease,transform 180ms var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-canvas-stage:hover{transform:scale(1.012)}.ds-canvas-stage:active{transform:scale(1.02)}.ds-canvas-stage:focus-visible{outline:0}.ds-canvas-stage:focus-visible .ds-keyboard-cursor{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}

narrative.overview:
LatteArt treats the screen as a near-black oxblood lacquer tray, with the matte porcelain cup as the clear center of attention. The atmosphere is modern and intuitive with the comfortable maturity of a retro café: warm, quiet, tactile, and composed rather than nostalgic or ornamental.

Interaction follows a serving ritual. People select one of three tools, work directly on the cup, tune details only when needed, and raise the bottom tray to finish. Flat smoked-frosted controls stay subordinate to the craft; copper hairlines, restrained wine accents, and layered ambient depth provide structure without making the interface feel bubbly or flashy.
keyCharacteristics: The live porcelain-and-coffee stage is the dominant visual and interactive object.
Near-black lacquer, warm oxblood, copper, and porcelain create a mature café palette.
Controls are flat, frosted, restrained, and comfortably touchable.
Mobile, touch, keyboard, and reduced-motion experiences are first-class.
Completion feels like raising a serving tray, not submitting a dashboard form.

rules.name: The Porcelain Priority Rule
rules.body: Matte porcelain owns the brightest value; accents must not compete with the cup or primary text.

rules.name: The Copper Rarity Rule
rules.body: Copper marks ceremony, completion, or a decisive boundary. It is never a general-purpose decoration.

rules.name: The One Bodoni Gesture Rule
rules.body: Use the display face for the LatteArt signature, not as a decorative heading system.

rules.name: The Cup-First Rule
rules.body: Responsive changes protect the largest practical circular work surface before adding chrome or spacing.

rules.name: The Ambient Layers Rule
rules.body: Elevation comes from broad, low-contrast shadows and tonal overlap; never use bubbly specular highlights or exaggerated floating cards.

rules.name: The One Dominant Circle Rule
rules.body: The cup is the primary circle; supporting circles must be small and functional.

dos: Do keep the porcelain cup as the brightest, largest, and most immediate element.
Do use shared frosted planes and hairline dividers to group related controls.
Do preserve 44–48px touch targets, safe-area padding, visible focus, keyboard operation, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do make motion feel like serving: short state transitions around 180–260ms and larger tray or stage transitions around 480–720ms with the expressive ease.
Do use restrained line icons and concise labels; components should feel refined, tactile, and calm.
donts: Don't introduce childish color, emoji, playful stickers, or candy-bright accents.
Don't use bubbly or flashy liquid-glass effects, glossy capsules, or excessive blur and shine.
Don't scatter unrelated floating cards around the cup or turn the experience into a generic simulator dashboard.
Don't overuse copper, Bodoni, or strong wine fills; their rarity preserves hierarchy.
Don't reduce the canvas to make room for secondary settings when a sheet can reveal them on demand.
